toegepas.na: Dan vorm die juwelier die metaal
toegepas.rede_vinder: The pronoun 'sy' sits two sentences away from 'n Juwelier', after sentences about the gold and the rings, so naming the jeweller again makes the reference clear.
toegepas.fout: The pronoun 'sy' first appears two sentences after 'n Juwelier', following a general statement about rings, so the reader has to look back to find who is meant.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the jeweller again re-anchors the actor without changing the meaning, and the following 'Sy poleer' then reads cleanly.

na_skrywer.blok: Wat die goud se pad kos
na_skrywer.na: Om diep te grawe en lang tonnels te maak.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Diep grawe' can be read as an adjective plus the plural of 'graaf' (deep spades); a verb construction makes the activity unambiguous.
na_skrywer.fout: 'Diep grawe' can be read as 'deep spades' (plural of graaf), which is plausible in a list of costs.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The ambiguity is real, but the proposed infinitive clause breaks the noun-phrase pattern of the other list items and lengthens the item, so the writer should choose the fix.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

laat_vaar_vorige.na: en die werk in die myn laat doen
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'sy' could refer to the business or the mine; naming the mine's work removes the ambiguity without changing the meaning.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'sy' naturally points to the mine and either reading means the same, while 'in die myn' narrows the work to underground and rewords a shared glossary definition.
